item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 31/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon affecting Guangdong will moderate in the next couple of days. Temperatures will rise gradually over the region, but it will still be rather cool today morning, and temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. The band of clouds now covering the northern part of the South China Sea is expected to edge closer to the coast of Guangdong during the New Year holidays. With the strengthening of an anticyclone aloft, it will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China midweek next week.
